label: Country
notes: ISO 3166 numeric country codes, stored as text.

label: Parental occupational status (ISEI)
notes: International Socio-Economic Index of occupational status of the father or mother; higher = higher-status occupation.

label: Reading ability estimate (WLE)
notes: Weighted likelihood (Warm) estimate on the PISA 2000 reading scale; reading and pass_rea are derived from it.

label: Highest parental education is high school
notes: high_sch and college are never both 1; both are 0 for 1,529 students (the reference group).

label: One parent born abroad
notes: one_for and both_for are never both 1; both 0 means neither parent was born abroad.

label: Home language is the test language
Reading proficiency level
values: 0 = below level 1; 1 = level 1; 2 = level 2; 3 = level 3; 4 = level 4; 5 = level 5
notes: Derived from wleread: the levels start at about 335, 407, 480, 553 and 626 points (the PISA 2000 cut-points).

label: Proficient in reading (level 4 or 5)
notes: Equals 1 exactly when reading is 4 or 5; the v0.2.0 help page wrongly said level 3 or higher.

label: School ID
notes: Unique across countries: UK 1 to 520, Germany 621 to 839, US 840 to 990.
